35625-a-philosophical-dictionary-volume-.title: Volume V
35625-a-philosophical-dictionary-volume-.creator: Voltaire
35625-a-philosophical-dictionary-volume-.description: A book by Voltaire. Let us imagine an immense rotunda, a pantheon, with innumerable altars placed under its dome. Let us figure to ourselves a devotee of every sect, whether at present existing or extinct, at the feet of that divinity which he worships in his own peculiar way, under all the extravagant forms which human imagination has been able to invent.

arxiv-2105-14846.title: A Stably Irrational (2,3)-Complete Intersection Fourfold over ℚ \mathbb{Q}
arxiv-2105-14846.creator: Bjørn Skauli
arxiv-2105-14846.description: Abstract We apply the specialization technique based on the decomposition of the diagonal from [ Tot16 ] and [ Sch19 ] to find an explicit example over ℚ \mathbb{Q} of a quadric and cubic hypersurface in ℙ 6 \mathbb{P}^{6} such that their intersection is a smooth stably irrational fourfold.

CCS: Softw
arxiv-2204-06447.creator: Michael Schlichtig, Anna-Katharina Wickert, Stefan Krüger, Eric Bodden, Mira Mezini
arxiv-2204-06447.description: Abstract . Context: Cryptographic APIs are often misused in real-world applications. To mitigate that, many cryptographic API misuse detection tools have been introduced. However, there exists no established reference benchmark for a fair and comprehensive comparison and evaluation of these tools.

arxiv-2206-07464.title: Proposition of extension of models relating rheological quantities and microscopic structure through the use of a double fractal structure
arxiv-2206-07464.creator: Louis-Vincent Bouthier, Romain Castellani, Elie Hachem, Rudy Valette
arxiv-2206-07464.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Louis-Vincent Bouthier, Romain Castellani, Elie Hachem, Rudy Valette. Colloidal suspensions and the relation between their rheology and their microstructure is investigated. The literature showed great evidence of the relation between rheological quantities and particle volume fraction, ignoring the influence of the cluster. We propose to extend previous models using a new double fractal structure which allows, first, to recover the well-known models on the case of percolated system and, second, to capture the influence of the cluster size.

arxiv-2210-04572.title: Floorplan-Aware Camera Poses Refinement
arxiv-2210-04572.creator: Anna Sokolova, Filipp Nikitin, Anna Vorontsova, Anton Konushin
arxiv-2210-04572.description: Abstract Processing large indoor scenes is a challenging task, as scan registration and camera trajectory estimation methods accumulate errors across time. As a result, the quality of reconstructed scans is insufficient for some applications, such as visual-based localization and navigation, where the correct position of walls is crucial.

arxiv-2308-13831.title: Topological superconductivity from first-principles II: Effects from manipulation of spin spirals − - Topological fragmentation, braiding, and Quasi-Majorana Bound States
arxiv-2308-13831.creator: András Lászlóffy 1, Bendegúz Nyári 2, Gábor Csire 3,4, László Szunyogh 2,5, Balázs Újfalussy 1
arxiv-2308-13831.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by András Lászlóffy 1, Bendegúz Nyári 2, Gábor Csire 3,4, László Szunyogh 2,5, Balázs Újfalussy 1. Recent advances in electron spin resonance techniques have allowed the manipulation of the spin of individual atoms, making magnetic atomic chains on superconducting hosts one of the most promising platform where topological superconductivity can be engineered.

arxiv-2310-03477.title: Tik-to-Tok: Translating Language Models One Token at a Time: An Embedding Initialization Strategy for Efficient Language Adaptation
arxiv-2310-03477.creator: François Remy, Pieter Delobelle, Bettina Berendt, Kris Demuynck, Thomas Demeester francois.remy@ugent.be pieter.delobelle@kuleuven.be
arxiv-2310-03477.description: Abstract Training monolingual language models for low and mid-resource languages is made challenging by limited and often inadequate pretraining data. In this study, we propose a novel model conversion strategy to address this issue, adapting high-resources monolingual language models to a new target language.

arxiv-2401-10353.title: Inconsistent dialogue responses and how to recover from them
arxiv-2401-10353.creator: Mian Zhang ⧫, Lifeng Jin ♡, Linfeng Song ♡, Haitao Mi ♡, Dong Yu ♡
arxiv-2401-10353.description: Abstract One critical issue for chat systems is to stay consistent about preferences, opinions, beliefs and facts of itself, which has been shown a difficult problem. In this work, we study methods to assess and bolster utterance consistency of chat systems.

arxiv-2406-11894.title: Topographic Visualization of Near-surface Temperatures for Improved Lapse Rate Estimation
arxiv-2406-11894.creator: \authororcid Kevin Höhlein0000-0002-4483-8388, \authororcid Timothy Hewson0000-0002-3266-8828, and \authororcid Rüdiger Westermann0000-0002-3394-0731
arxiv-2406-11894.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by \authororcid Kevin Höhlein0000-0002-4483-8388, \authororcid Timothy Hewson0000-0002-3266-8828, and \authororcid Rüdiger Westermann0000-0002-3394-0731. Numerical model forecasts of near-surface temperatures are prone to error. This is because terrain can exert a strong influence on temperature that is not captured in numerical weather models due to spatial resolution limitations. To account for the terrain height difference between the forecast model and reality, temperatures are commonly corrected using a vertical adjustment based on a fixed lapse rate.

arxiv-2406-12932.title: Brownian Motion of the Quantum States on a String and the Polyakov Action of String Theory: Is String Theory a Quantum Mechanical Model of the Brain?
arxiv-2406-12932.creator: Amir Abbass Varshovi
arxiv-2406-12932.description: Abstract Abstract: The Brownian motion of a number of quantum states in a compact one-dimensional space is studied via the Wiener fractal measure, and it is shown that the derived path-integral measure coincides precisely with the Polyakov path-integral formula for bosonic string theory.

arxiv-2409-15134.title: SCMAlgebras: a Macaulay2 package for sequentially Cohen-Macaulayness Thanks: SCMAlgebras v1.2
arxiv-2409-15134.creator: Ernesto Lax
arxiv-2409-15134.description: Abstract . We introduce the Macaulay2 package SCMAlgebras . It provides functions for computing the modules of deficiency and the filter ideals, in order to check whether a module or an ideal is sequentially Cohen-Macaulay. The package also implements routines for studying other Cohen-Macaulay type conditions and unmixedness.

arxiv-2410-13611.title: H2OVL-Mississippi Vision Language Models Technical Report
arxiv-2410-13611.creator: Shaikat Galib Shanshan Wang Guanshuo Xu Pascal Pfeiffer
arxiv-2410-13611.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Smaller vision-language models (VLMs) are becoming increasingly important for privacy-focused, on-device applications due to their ability to run efficiently on consumer hardware for processing enterprise commercial documents and images. These models require strong language understanding and visual capabilities to enhance human-machine interaction.

arxiv-2411-08287.title: Tuning the Quasi-bound States of Double-barrier Structures: Insights from Resonant Tunneling Spectra
arxiv-2411-08287.creator: Wei Li, Yong Yang
arxiv-2411-08287.description: Abstract In this work, we study the resonant tunneling (RT) of electrons and H atoms in double-barrier (DB) systems. Our numerical calculations directly verify the correspondence between the resonant tunneling energies and the energy levels of quasi-bound states (QBS) within the double barriers.

pmc-11334347.creator: Carl O’BRIEN, Jacqui STOWE, Michael O’CONNOR, Jacinta MORGAN, Paul MURPHY, Darren RODDY, Kirk LEVINS
pmc-11334347.description: This case presents a 35-year-old male with spinal predominant neurofibromatosis-1 who developed an incomplete spinal cord injury (C3 Asia C) which did not improve despite urgent decompressive surgery for multiple cervical neurofibromas. This report outlines a novel indication for intrathecal baclofen.

pmc-12605835.title: Hydrogen-driven, ATP-dependent biocatalytic reduction of carboxylic acids under non-explosive conditions
pmc-12605835.creator: Marianna Karava, Qian Liang, Elske van der Pol, Margit Winkler, Robert Kourist
pmc-12605835.description: The reduction of carboxylic acids to alcohols is a key chemical transformation. We present a whole-cell biocatalyst employing carboxylic acid reductases and H2 for cofactor regeneration. H2 as a reductant ensures high atom and mass efficiency, enabling a more sustainable route to alcohols. Notably, we showcase that the reaction proceeds under O2-limited conditions, demonstrating potential for safer bioprocesses.

pmc-13240859.title: Single-cell profiling of kinase substrate phosphorylation by single-molecule imaging
pmc-13240859.creator: Takuya Hidaka, Ryotaro Motoya, Gao Jintian, Sooyeon Kim, Yuichi Taniguchi, Mauro Salvi, Mauro Salvi, Mauro Salvi, Mauro Salvi
pmc-13240859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Protein phosphorylation regulates diverse cellular processes, yet its analysis at the single-cell level remains challenging due to the low abundance of phosphoproteins. Here, we present a highly sensitive system for profiling phosphorylation of kinase substrates in individual cells. The method integrates fluorescence labeling of single-cell proteomes, immunoprecipitation using antibodies recognizing phosphorylation within specific amino acid motifs, miniaturized SDS-PAGE, and single-molecule detection using a custom-built light-sheet fluorescence microscope.

pmc-13339399.title: Alterations in resting‐state functional connectivity relate to psychopathology trajectories during emerging adolescence
pmc-13339399.creator: Jenna Jones Devine, Garrett R. Hosterman, Jolee Sloss, Adrienne L. Romer
pmc-13339399.description: BackgroundA general psychopathology “p‐factor” captures shared variation across psychiatric disorder categories and is associated with dysfunctions in cognitive control. Alterations in resting‐state functional connectivity (RSFC) of cognitive and attentional networks have been associated concurrently with the p‐factor in youth samples.

pmc-13352019.title: Clinical Outcomes of the Prospective Pakistan Registry of Echocardiographic Screening in Asymptomatic Pregnant Women
pmc-13352019.creator: Sabha Bhatti, Sumyia Gurmani, Shakeela Naz, Haleema Yasmin, Shazia Ahmed, Kiran Zehra, Wajid Hussain, Uzma Atif, Nazli Hossain, Musa Karim, Abdul Hakeem
pmc-13352019.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCardiovascular disease is increasingly recognized as a leading nonobstetric cause of maternal morbidity and mortality worldwide, including low- and middle-income countries.ObjectivesThis study evaluated fetomaternal outcomes in women with and without structural heart disease (SHD).MethodsFrom a total of 25,000 patients enrolled in the Prospective Pakistan Registry of Echocardiographic Screening in Asymptomatic Pregnant Women registry between February 2023 and April 2025, 489 pregnancies with SHD were identified and compared with 510 pregnancies without SHD.
